title: Uniform mean on the three-dimensional sign cube
statement: For every function $g:\{−1,1\}^3\to\mathbb R$, its uniform mean over the three-dimensional sign cube equals $\frac18\sum_{a,b,c\in\{−1,1\}}g(a,b,c)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on the three-dimensional sign cube
